# Inference schema fixtures

`agc-schema.json` snapshots the validation contract generated by
`ai-gateway-controller` for RHOAIENG-90800 at commit
`233179ce7bd11c7181e570388c72445eed8752ac`.
Descriptions are omitted so
generator documentation changes do not obscure API drift.

`installed-legacy-schema.json` preserves the MaaS-installed validation baseline
from `models-as-a-service` commit `353a85e841d8442afc976a539e49e2925b73e017`,
under `deployment/base/maas-controller/crd/bases`. It matches the copies packaged
in `ai-gateway-operator/config/manifests/maascontroller/crd/bases` at the time of
this synchronization.

For an agreed API change, mirror AGC's `common_types.go`,
`externalmodel_types.go` and `externalprovider_types.go`, run
`make generate manifests`, and refresh `agc-schema.json` from AGC's generated
`v1alpha1` OpenAPI schemas with descriptions removed. Keep the legacy fixture
unchanged. CI compares the generated local schemas with both fixtures and runs
API-server admission and upgrade tests through `make test-unit`.
